description: A white round tabletop piece with a cross-shaped center post sits on the wooden surface in front of you, with both hands nearby. The right hand reaches in from the right to grasp the cross-shaped post as a right-hand object, lifts and twists it upward to disengage it from the round base while the left hand stays resting near the base, then the right hand carries the removed post to the right and sets it down, leaving the round base in place.
